frequency_question: How often do union strike threats or conciliation failures in the banking sector proceed to an indefinite strike within 39 days?
membership_rule: Includes industry-wide union federation strike notices, conciliation meeting breakdowns, or strike ballots in major banking systems; excludes single-bank local disputes or non-banking sectors.
window: 39 days from notice or escalation point

cases.name: All India Bank Employees Association strike (Dec 2021)

coverage_note: 8 named recent instances representing major federation-level escalation cycles; estimated to capture the relevant active base rate.
known_gaps: Some regional or minor token strikes might be underrepresented, but indefinite strike threats are well-documented.
skeleton: Total recorded strike escalation cycles by national banking union federations resulting in formal strike notices, where conciliation processes are active.
multiplier: 8 historical instances evaluated for formal strike notice progression within the specified short-term window.
validity_reason: Labor relations frameworks and union federation dynamics evolve slowly over multi-year cycles.
